name: com.uee03.pretzel.pooling
description: Prefab pools on UnityEngine.Pool with prewarming, IPoolable reset hooks, self-releasing PooledObject, Inspector-configured keyed PoolFactory and a per-prefab PoolRegistry.

samples.description: An enum-keyed projectile factory configured in the Inspector, with prewarming and projectiles that release themselves after a delay.
A wave spawner on a keyed PoolFactory: prewarm sizing, a cap on live enemies, return callbacks and live pool metrics.
A turret with pooled bullets that spawn pooled impact effects through a small interface, on PoolRegistry and ComponentPool.
Pooled UI Toolkit labels for damage numbers using UnityEngine.Pool.ObjectPool, animated without layout passes.
